summary: Removed coefficient-reconstruction items, replaced unsupported parameter and classification tasks, and restricted sketch tasks to stationary coordinates and derivative-sign intervals while preserving valid numerical values. Added adapted worked examples for every assessed method, derived all retained and revised answers, and clarified the strict derivative condition at the increasing-function parameter boundary.
reviewSummary: All 28 final items have correct answers, appropriate methods and supported booklet question types; every quiz has exactly one correct option with accurate distractor explanations. The theory and four removals are accepted, and the examples cover every assessed method without introducing more advanced demands.
